subject: Pilot success choreography and exec ceremony planning
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Arianna Flores <arianna.flores@nimblebio.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@nimblebio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot success choreography and exec ceremony planning

Hi Arianna / Evan —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the pilot timeline and an exec "ceremony" (short readout + decision window) for late-Aug/early-Sep. TL;DR: agree success criteria, confirm owners and telemetry, schedule 45-minute exec slot for final decision, and circulate mutual action plan + contract trigger items.

Call highlights / proposed pilot plan:
- Duration: 4 weeks (observability + throughput tests in week 1–2; qualitative QA and edge-case review week 3; stakeholder readout week 4)
- Focus flows: chart ingestion -> summary -> clinician Q&A (50k tokens/day sim)
- Success criteria (initial): 95% intent accuracy on the clinician set; median 95th pctl latency < 350ms; no PII leakage incidents in test set; end-to-end cost projection within agreed budget (see attached).

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood infra/ops: Monica (runbook, dashboards, perf tuning)
- Redwood account exec: Sean (commercial cadence, exec coordination)
- NimbleBio technical lead: Evan (test harness, golden prompts)
- NimbleBio evaluation sponsor: Arianna (final decision/purchase owner)

Action items I need from you by EOD Wed, Aug 13:
1) Confirm or edit the success criteria in the attached spreadsheet (nimblebio-success-criteria-v2.xlsx).
2) Confirm the preferred week for the exec ceremony (options below).
3) Any procurement constraints (DocuSign timeline, PO cadence) so we can align contract triggers.

Proposed exec ceremony slots (45 min, with 10 min for Qs + 10 min buffer):
- Tue Aug 26, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Aug 27, 15:00–15:45 PT
- Thu Sep 4, 09:00–09:45 PT

I've attached an updated mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan-v3.docx) that maps milestones, owners, and contract triggers. If these slots don't work, propose 2 alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: nimblebio-success-criteria-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), mutual-action-plan-v3.docx (MAL)
From: Arianna Flores <arianna.flores@nimblebio.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@nimblebio.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot success choreography and exec ceremony planning

Thanks Sean — great summary. Quick responses inline below: 

Success criteria: overall we like the framing. Two adjustments: add a qualitative "clinician satisfaction" target (avg >= 4.2/5 on our 50-case panel) and measure hallucination rate on the critical medication-field at <1%. I'll mark these in the spreadsheet.

Pilot duration: 4 weeks works. Can we shift the perf-heavy tests to the second week (we want the test harness to be warmed in week 1)?

Owners: confirmed — Evan will be point for the harness; I'll be the decision sponsor. I'll loop in Procurement (procurement@nimblebio.com) separately about DocuSign timing; they usually need a 7–10 business day window once commercial terms are final.

Exec ceremony: Wed Aug 27 15:00 PT works best for our execs (I can secure Arianna + 1 more). Please pencil that slot. 

We reviewed the mutual action plan — good level of detail. A few doc comments on delivery acceptance criteria (added to v3 comments).

Next: Evan will send the harness timeline by tomorrow; I'll confirm procurement cadence by EOD Wed.

— Arianna
Arianna Flores
Director, Digital Clinical Ops | NimbleBio
arianna.flores@nimblebio.com | (206) 555-0123
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Arianna Flores <arianna.flores@nimblebio.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot success choreography and exec ceremony planning

Thanks Arianna — noted. Couple of operational clarifications from my side so we don't get blocked mid-run:

1) Telemetry and dashboards: I'll provision a trial dashboard (token counts, latency percentiles, per-prompt error rails, hallucination probe results) and share access to Evan by EOD Friday. Please confirm Evan's Google account for dashboard access.
2) Test harness specifics: we need a CSV with sample prompts and expected labels for the clinician panel. Evan, can you share the first tranche by tomorrow?
3) Failure modes & rollback: propose an automatic failover to a 2nd model family if we see sustained >0.5% error on the medication field for two consecutive hours. We should document the rollback in the MAL.

I'll also run a quick dry-run of the onboarding playbook with your team the morning of Aug 18 (30 min). Marissa — want to join the dry-run to cover contractual acceptance checkpoints?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@nimblebio.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Arianna Flores <arianna.flores@nimblebio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 10:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot success choreography and exec ceremony planning

Monica / Sean —

Sending the first tranche of the harness CSV as discussed (10 sample prompts + expected labels). Note: these are de-identified but reflect the tricky medication examples we flagged. I'll also create a shared folder for telemetry creds.

On the dashboard access: please grant viewer to evan.liu@nimblebio.com. The team will run performance sims in week 2 as requested. 

Quick question on the rollback threshold: is the 0.5% over two hours a hard stop (automatic), or can we trigger a manual mitigation first? Procurement will want clarity in the MAL.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Liu
Sr. Engineering Manager | NimbleBio
evan.liu@nimblebio.com

Attachments: nimblebio-harness-tranche1.csv (sample prompts)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Arianna Flores <arianna.flores@nimblebio.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@nimblebio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, NimbleBio Procurement <procurement@nimblebio.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot success choreography and exec ceremony planning

All — thanks for the quick turn. Final items before I lock the calendar and circulate the exec agenda:

- Slot confirmed: Wed Aug 27, 15:00–15:45 PT — calendar invite will go out from my side.
- Success criteria updated: Arianna's clinician satisfaction and medication-field hallucination metric are added in v2 of the spreadsheet (attached).
- Rollback behavior: Monica and I propose the following MAL language: "If medication-field hallucination rate >0.5% sustained over a 2-hour window, Redwood will pause the pilot traffic and automatically route to the fallback model. The parties will convene an incident review within 4 business hours to determine next steps; manual mitigation may be attempted prior to automatic failover but will not exceed the 2-hour protection window." Please confirm acceptance — Procurement, flag if you need edits for contract language.
- Procurement timeline: Arianna indicated 7–10bd after commercial terms. Procurement, if you can confirm required PO/DocuSign lead time we will map the contract trigger accordingly.

Next steps for each owner (due dates included in MAL):
- Monica: dashboard & runbook (Aug 22)
- Evan: harness tranche & access (completed)
- Arianna: procurement confirmation (Aug 13 — pending)
- Sean: calendar invite + exec agenda doc (sent Aug 15 morning)

Attachments: nimblebio-success-criteria-v2.xlsx (finalized with Arianna's comments), mutual-action-plan-v3.docx

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
